source: Recorded read-only from the GitHub API with gh on 2026-09-19 by the phase-1 author. prs: every PR merged 2026-08-10..2026-09-14 (GraphQL search, full timelines) reduced by prFacts(); builds: per-day merge_group run counts of typecheck.yml (one per queue build) and how many were cancelled; jobs: job durations from an evenly spaced sample of test.yml and browser-test.yml runs (40 runs per event in each before-window, 60 in each after-window), because fetching every run would have cost thousands of requests. coverage says how many runs each window had and how many were sampled.
